$comment: Every external host in the app's code (lib/, app/, packages/, components/ and root files). "requests" are the hosts the app contacts and must match the README section "数据与外部连接" (see DEVELOPMENT.md, Outbound connections). "notRequested" hosts only appear as links or plain strings, and only in the files listed. lib/outbound-hosts.test.ts fails on anything else.

requests.api.manus.ai: Optional Manus key check, user-confirmed keyword research and reading its status and results
requests.private.manuscdn.com: Signed workbook and Markdown report downloads for an existing Manus task
requests.private-us-east-1.manuscdn.com: Regional signed workbook and Markdown report downloads for an existing Manus task
requests.auth.openai.com: Optional local ChatGPT app OAuth, JWKS verification, token renewal and session revocation
requests.api.openai.com: Optional ChatGPT app model catalog and explicitly requested draft generation using the authorized plan
requests.accounts.google.com: Google sign-in: Auth.js OIDC discovery and the browser redirect (not a literal in our code)
requests.oauth2.googleapis.com: Google OAuth tokens (sign-in, refresh) and revoke on disconnect
requests.www.googleapis.com: Search Console and PageSpeed Insights APIs; also the OAuth scope names
requests.analyticsdata.googleapis.com: Manually requested GA4 read-only AI session reports
requests.ssl.bing.com: Bing Webmaster Tools API, only with the user's own key
requests.api.dataforseo.com: DataForSEO API, only with the user's own key
requests.api.github.com: Optional daily update check, only when UPDATE_CHECK_REPO names a repository

manus.im.reason: Private task page for a Manus research task, opened in the user's browser

open.manus.ai.reason: Official Manus authentication guide opened from Settings

developers.openai.com.reason: Official crawler reference opened only by the user

privacy.claude.com.reason: Official crawler reference opened only by the user

docs.perplexity.ai.reason: Official crawler reference opened only by the user

schema.org.reason: JSON-LD vocabulary identifier checked locally; no remote context is fetched

chatgpt.com.reason: ChatGPT usage settings opened by the user; no request from A-Border SEO

github.com.reason: Release page link in the sidebar footer (only with UPDATE_CHECK_REPO), opened by the user

console.cloud.google.com.reason: Help links in Settings > Connections and the GA4 setup guide

ssad.shop.reason: Existing content planner example URLs, stored as references; no request is made by the seed function

knowledge.hubspot.com.reason: Existing concept guide reference links, opened only by the user

blog.hubspot.com.reason: Existing concept guide reference links, opened only by the user

dataforseo.com.reason: Provider pricing link opened by the user before paid research

developers.google.com.reason: Official crawler reference opened only by the user

analytics.google.com.reason: Google Analytics link in the GA4 setup guide, opened by the user
